results.name: Flood in Thessaly and Sterea Ellada regions, Greece
results.reason: Following the early warning sent by the European Flood Alert System (EFAS) on 26 September regarding possible flood events in Thessaly and Sterea Ellada Regions,  the Greek authorities requested an activation for these areas. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide an initial rough estimation and flood extent of the possible events for the emergency mapping.
results.activator: Greece|General secretariat for Civil protection - Directorate for Emergency Planning and Response
